definitions.explanation: Of rain, snow, or wind: blowing hard from the side rather than falling straight down. Also a blow struck from the side.

examples.japanese: {横殴|よこなぐ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧。

examples.english: I can't see ahead for the snow driving sideways.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づき→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧、{横殴|よこなぐ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧まったく⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}たなかった→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧。
examples.english: As the typhoon approached, the sideways rain and wind made my umbrella completely useless.

notes:
⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (side) + ⟦{殴|なぐ}る→殴る：02378_naguru⟧ (to hit): literally "hitting from the side." Almost always 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ before a weather noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {横殴|よこなぐ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧: driving rain
- {横殴|よこなぐ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧: snow blowing sideways
- {横殴|よこなぐ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧: a side wind

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {吹|ふ}き{降|ぶ}り: a storm of wind and rain together
- ⟦{土砂降|どしゃぶ}り→土砂降り：07680_doshaburi⟧: a downpour, very heavy rain (says nothing about direction)
